dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds like you need a few more hands around here.

dialogues.speaker: Lev
dialogues.text: Ha! Bless you for saying that. I pray for more help every day, but no one ever answers.

dialogues.speaker: Lev
dialogues.text: More hands or more pay, either one would be enough for me. But instead, the work just keeps piling up, and every job is more troublesome than the last.

dialogues.speaker: Lev
dialogues.text: I've brought it up with the people upstairs, too. But they always give me the same old answer: "Not enough funding."

dialogues.speaker: Lev
dialogues.text: ...*sigh* Then just look at these costly stage decorations. I ought to retire tomorrow. No, right now.

dialogues.speaker: Lev
dialogues.text: Anyway, unless you have other business here, you should leave. I need a little room to work.
